faq.q: Is Delta Manor an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. It is the Paragon sub-area name for the central Ladner grid around Delta Secondary School and Memorial Park; the governing plan is the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400 — a single consolidated plan, in which the former Ladner Area Plan (Schedule B.3 of the superseded Bylaw No. 3950) no longer exists as a schedule.

faq.q: Are secondary suites allowed in the single detached zones here?
faq.a: Yes — the RS1 zone in Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600 lists a secondary suite as an accessory use to a single detached dwelling, and the City's SSMUH amendments also cover secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies.

faq.q: How does transit connect Delta Manor to Richmond and Vancouver?
faq.a: TransLink route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line, stopping at Ladner Exchange, and route 618 loops Ladner North from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Westminster Avenue and Crescent Drive.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Delta Manor?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
